For each intent: prompt an instruction-tuned LLM via hosted API to produce device-specific CLI or API changes (repeatable prompts, fixed seeds where available). Two pipelines: (A) LLM-only (deploy output as-is); (B) LLM+verifier: pass LLM output to a deterministic network verifier (Batfish-like static analyzer) that either (1) approves, (2) rejects, or (3) suggests repairs via a single automated repair attempt using constrained LLM re-prompting. Deploy resulting configs into parameterized Mininet topologies representing small-to-medium enterprise networks; execute automated reachability tests and policy checks. Inject controlled faults (link flaps, device down, baseline config drift) in 30% of tasks to simulate production perturbations. All prompts, model responses, verifier logs, deploy outcomes, and test results preserved. Preregister task set, seeds, verifier rules, and fault-injection schedule before execution.","expected_data":"Per-task records including: original intent ID; raw LLM outputs; verifier decision (approve/reject/repair); repaired config if any; Mininet deploy logs; reachability test matrices before and after deploy; policy-compliance boolean; injected faults metadata; timestamps; counts of blocked vs deployed changes. Aggregated data: failure rates per pipeline, distribution of failure types, conditional failure rates under fault injection.","primary_outcome":"Difference in proportion of tasks resulting in operational failure (reachability loss or policy violation) between LLM-only and LLM+verifier pipelines (LLM+verifier expected to have lower failure proportion).","analysis_outline":"Compute per-pipeline operational-failure proportions with 95% confidence intervals (Wilson or exact binomial). Use paired comparison (McNemar's test) on matched tasks to test reduction significance. Report absolute and relative risk reduction and number-needed-to-protect. Stratify results by task type (ACL, routing, VLAN) and by presence/absence of injected faults; analyze residual failures qualitatively with representative examples and failure-mode taxonomy. For each task, capture LLM output, retrieval evidence used, verifier/ensemble decisions, and deploy in lightweight simulation (or Mininet for a representative subset) to obtain operational outcome (reachability/policy). Compute retrieval precision@k, verifier detection rates, and final deploy failure rates. Use the same task bank and pipelines as in the verifier experiments (LLM+verifier and LLM+RAG+verifier-ensemble). Specify scoring: reachability pass-rate, policy-compliance score, mean-time-to-detect failure in simulation, and a composite Safety Score.
